provenance.procedure: GET /tv/12345 with an Authorization: Bearer <v4 read access token>; synthesised from the published TMDB v3 /tv/{id} contract (ADR-0026). Regenerate against a real token with scripts/capture-fixtures.sh tmdb series.
provenance.note: Synthesised: TMDB has no single 'all episodes' endpoint, so the series detail is the index Enumerate walks — the client reads only the seasons array (each season_number), then fetches each season for its episodes. The seasons are listed HERE out of order (season 2 before season 1) on purpose, to prove the client enumerates in season-number order rather than in the order the service happened to list them. Fields beyond season_number are omitted deliberately — the client tolerates extra fields but the corpus should only assert what it consumes.
